notes.title: DEV BLOG #002: SUPERSONIC FIGHT - BACK TO BASICS
notes.content:
Hey Supersonic Squadron, 

I’ve been working on some exciting new features: from recording replays for PVP to fighting the uncanny valley on behalf of Supersonic Fight’s NPCs (have you ever noticed how little attention is paid to NPCs in sim games?!).

For a change of pace, and to rigorously test these new developments, I swapped the beloved F/A-18 Hornet jets of our actual game for the classic charm of Sopwith Camel biplanes - a nostalgic nod to aviation history. This choice isn't just a whimsical deviation; it's a testament to the freedom and creativity that being a solo developer affords me - the power to blend history with modern gaming tech. Dive into the video below to witness this fusion of past and present. I would love to hear what you think of this!

[previewyoutube=0MeglDFanBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]SUPERSONIC (DOG)FIGHT[/b][/h1]

Not only will the final version of the game feature these magnificent men in their flying machines as a playable option, but it will also include a PVP or team dogfight experience. The video above showcases an intriguing glimpse into this aspect – watch as the planes engage in an intricate aerial ballet, demonstrating the sophisticated flight modeling I've been fine-tuning. What makes this even more special is knowing that every maneuver and aerial dance you see was captured directly from a game-testing session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42909735/32485e81912ee82b9727ffda1bce7bd096ac9caa.gif[/img]

[h1][b]JOIN THE SQUADRON[/b][/h1]

To become a part of the thrilling journey with Supersonic Fight, I warmly invite you to join our vibrant community across social media platforms: 
[url=https://discord.com/invite/tawwzKDB2z]Discord[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/RedChainGames]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/@redchaingames]YouTube[/url] | [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@redchaingames]TikTok[/url]

Thanks for reading!
Rich
